sections.Profile:
"Title Fight" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in October 1990, featuring a boxing theme. The game has five flippers, no ramps, and a two-ball multiball mode. It is part of the Gottlieb System 3 series, with artwork by Constantino Mitchell, David Moore, and Jeanine Mitchell. Only 1,000 units were produced, making it relatively rare.
